tasks.label: run-jobservice
tasks.command: dapr run --app-id jobservice --app-port 5000 --dapr-http-port 3500 --dapr-grpc-port 50001 --resources-path ./deploy/dapr/components --log-level info -- dotnet run --project services/JobService/src/JobService.Api --urls http://localhost:5000

tasks.label: run-worker-1
tasks.command: dapr run --app-id workerservice --app-port 5101 --dapr-http-port 3501 --dapr-grpc-port 50011 --resources-path ./deploy/dapr/components --log-level info -- dotnet run --project services/WorkerService/src/WorkerService.Api --urls http://localhost:5101

tasks.label: run-worker-2
tasks.command: dapr run --app-id workerservice --app-port 5102 --dapr-http-port 3502 --dapr-grpc-port 50012 --resources-path ./deploy/dapr/components --log-level info -- dotnet run --project services/WorkerService/src/WorkerService.Api --urls http://localhost:5102

tasks.label: run-worker-3
tasks.command: dapr run --app-id workerservice --app-port 5103 --dapr-http-port 3503 --dapr-grpc-port 50013 --resources-path ./deploy/dapr/components --log-level info -- dotnet run --project services/WorkerService/src/WorkerService.Api --urls http://localhost:5103

tasks.label: stop-all-services
tasks.command: dapr stop --app-id jobservice; dapr stop --app-id workerservice; Get-Process daprd -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Stop-Process -Force; Write-Host 'All services stopped.'

tasks.label: stop-everything
tasks.command: dapr stop --app-id jobservice; dapr stop --app-id workerservice; Get-Process daprd -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Stop-Process -Force; docker compose -f deploy/compose/docker-compose.yml down; Write-Host 'All services and infrastructure stopped.'
